report.summary: Missing constant GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS causes NameError in GateResult.summary; job accounting may be lost in _spawn_pytest; Ollama policy weakness propagation unverified.
risks: Adding GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS to attempt.py changes global namespace; other modules may rely on NameError as a guard.
Inspecting _spawn_pytest may reveal accounting is already read before close; item becomes no-op.
Ollama policy weakness may be mitigated by existing validation; settling check may find no exploit.
todos: Define GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS in daedalus/spine/attempt.py with an appropriate integer value.
Inspect _spawn_pytest in daedalus/eval/correctness.py to ensure job_accounting is read before close.
Run settling checks for Ollama policy propagation to confirm or refute the weakness.
Add a unit test that calls GateResult.summary to verify no NameError.
Add a unit test that verifies job_accounting is read before close in all ManagedProcess callers.

items.title: Define missing constant GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS in attempt.py
items.why_now: Without this constant, GateResult.summary raises NameError, breaking a critical path in the attempt lifecycle. This is a confirmed critical defect.

steps.do: Add GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS = 2000 (or appropriate value) to daedalus/spine/attempt.py
steps.verified_by: Run: python -c 'from daedalus.spine.attempt import GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS; print(GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS)' should output the value without error.

steps.do: Add a test that calls GateResult.summary on an instance with a long output and verifies it truncates without raising NameError.

items.assumption: The appropriate value for GATE_OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS is 2000; adjust if different value is required.

items.title: Ensure job_accounting read before close in _spawn_pytest
items.why_now: The narrowed finding confirms that if close() is called without reading job_accounting first, accounting data is lost. _spawn_pytest is a concrete risk site.

steps.do: Inspect _spawn_pytest in daedalus/eval/correctness.py to verify job_accounting is read before the ManagedProcess context manager exits.
steps.verified_by: Grep for job_accounting in that file and confirm read occurs before close. If not, add a read before the context manager exit.

steps.do: Add a unit test that uses a mock ManagedProcess to verify that job_accounting is read before close.

items.assumption: The settling check will reveal whether the accounting read is already present; if so, this item is a no-op.

items.title: Verify Ollama policy weakness propagation
items.why_now: The finding is 'needs-evidence'; we need to confirm whether the weaker Ollama policy can bypass safety checks via fanout.py or session.py.

steps.do: Grep for _CHECK_POLICY in daedalus/providers/ollama.py and daedalus/providers/deepseek.py to compare policy definitions.
steps.verified_by: Command outputs the policy definitions; manual review determines if Ollama's is weaker.

steps.do: Grep for validate, sanitize, filter in daedalus/lanes/fanout.py and daedalus/council/session.py to see if cross-module validation exists.
steps.verified_by: Command outputs any validation logic; if none, the weakness is unmitigated.

items.assumption: The settling checks will reveal the actual policy content and consumer validation; without them the finding remains speculative.
